scaling_policy: one immutable experiment config -> one environment-bound receipt

experiments.claim_scope: archive-integrity/correctness/statistics audit only; no new BLAKE3 execution

quality_dimensions.accuracy: Reference-bound only; TOKEN_VAZIO without a declared golden digest.
quality_dimensions.execution_reliability: successful measured runs / attempted measured runs for one receipt
quality_dimensions.timing_margin: p95-p05 and relative spread for one receipt
quality_dimensions.confidence: distribution-free 95% median interval when n permits
quality_dimensions.reproducibility: cross-receipt identity/correctness comparison; independent-provider status remains separate
